title: Discrete-time polynomial systems with inputs and outputs: structure, reachability, observability, and minimal realizations
summary: We study the realization problem for discrete-time input/output polynomial systems. These are formalized using tools from commutative algebra and algebraic geometry as systems whose state spaces are algebraic varieties, or more abstractly the set of k-points of an affine k-scheme, where k is an arbitrary infinite field. The input/output behaviors of such systems are described by "polynomial response maps" in which outputs are polynomial functions of past inputs.
